header.title: Your company can scale social impact and transform communities.
header.lead: We connect corporate private social investment to audited, lasting outcomes in primary education, food security, and productive inclusion across the Federal District Suburbs.

modalities.title: Strategic Corporate Partnership Modalities
modalities.subtitle: Flexible collaboration models aligned with your organization's sustainability and ESG commitments.
modalities.tax_incentive_desc: Direct allocation of up to 1% of corporate income tax (Real Profit regime) to child protection funds and accredited initiatives at zero additional expense.
modalities.direct_desc: Multi-year capital funding for full academic scholarships, open-source robotics labs, and community solidarity kitchen infrastructure.
modalities.volunteer_desc: Integrated workforce engagement in career counseling for high schoolers, vocational coaching, and community revitalization workdays.
modalities.probono_desc: Hardware donations, refurbished computers, materials, and specialized technical consulting to advance institutional capacity.

benefits.title: Governance Excellence for Corporate Partners
benefits.subtitle: Legal certainty, fiduciary integrity, and rigorous impact auditing following global best practices.
benefits.compliance_desc: Quarterly accountability statements featuring verifiable Social Return on Investment (SROI) metrics and external audit sign-offs.
benefits.tax_desc: Non-profit entity fully certified with positive tax, labor, and municipal debt clearance certificates available for due diligence.
benefits.badge_desc: Authorized use of our verified institutional partnership badge for annual ESG reports, sustainability indices, and investor relations.
